# OpenVR header

Unmodified `headers/openvr.h` from ValveSoftware/openvr tag **v2.5.1**.
Copyright Valve Corporation, BSD-3-Clause; the upstream license is in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/blob/v2.5.1/headers/openvr.h

SHA-256: `94E5545370159C85F87CD6E15DD3739F7C919FC7A6E869F5E4ED463533A07ED0`

Used only by the opt-in `MEVR-VRLauncher` prototype. No import library or API binary is vendored.
The prototype loads `openvr_api.dll` by absolute path from the user's registered SteamVR installation.
